factoryName.metadata: Nombre de instancia de Data Factory

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT DISTINCT department AS nombre_departamento FROM silver.admissions',

query: 'SELECT icd_code AS codigo_icd, MAX(diagnosis_description) AS descripcion_patologia, ISNULL(NULLIF(severity,\'\'),\'Sin clasificar\') AS nivel_severidad FROM silver.diagnoses GROUP BY icd_code, ISNULL(NULLIF(severity,\'\'),\'Sin clasificar\') UNION ALL SELECT \'N/A\',\'Sin diagnóstico\',\'Sin clasificar\'',

query: 'SELECT CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), d, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key, d AS fecha_completa, YEAR(d) AS anio, DATEPART(QUARTER,d) AS trimestre, \'T\'+CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER,d) AS VARCHAR(1)) AS trimestre_nombre, MONTH(d) AS mes, CHOOSE(MONTH(d),\'Enero\',\'Febrero\',\'Marzo\',\'Abril\',\'Mayo\',\'Junio\',\'Julio\',\'Agosto\',\'Septiembre\',\'Octubre\',\'Noviembre\',\'Diciembre\') AS mes_nombre, CHOOSE(MONTH(d),\'Ene\',\'Feb\',\'Mar\',\'Abr\',\'May\',\'Jun\',\'Jul\',\'Ago\',\'Sep\',\'Oct\',\'Nov\',\'Dic\') AS mes_corto, DATEPART(ISO_WEEK,d) AS semana_anio, DAY(d) AS dia_mes, (DATEDIFF(DAY,\'19000101\',d)%7)+1 AS dia_semana, CHOOSE((DATEDIFF(DAY,\'19000101\',d)%7)+1,\'Lunes\',\'Martes\',\'Miercoles\',\'Jueves\',\'Viernes\',\'Sabado\',\'Domingo\') AS dia_nombre, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY,\'19000101\',d)%7>=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS es_fin_de_semana FROM (SELECT admission_date AS d FROM silver.admissions UNION SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions UNION SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing) f WHERE d IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT patient_id AS patient_id_bk, full_name AS nombre_completo, ISNULL(NULLIF(gender,\'\'),\'Otro\') AS genero, date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento, CASE WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR,date_of_birth,GETDATE())<=18 THEN \'0-18\' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR,date_of_birth,GETDATE())<=35 THEN \'19-35\' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR,date_of_birth,GETDATE())<=60 THEN \'36-60\' ELSE \'60+\' END AS rango_etario, email AS correo_electronico, address AS direccion, ISNULL(NULLIF(insurance_provider,\'\'),\'Desconocido\') AS proveedor_seguro FROM silver.patients',
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT ISNULL(NULLIF(charge_type,\'\'),\'Sin clasificar\') AS tipo_cargo, payment_status AS estado_pago FROM silver.billing',

query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, a.patient_id, a.department, ISNULL(dx.icd_code,\'N/A\') AS icd_code, ISNULL(NULLIF(dx.severity,\'\'),\'Sin clasificar\') AS severity, CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_ingreso_key, CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_alta_key, a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id, DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia, 1 AS conteo_admisiones FROM silver.admissions a LEFT JOIN (SELECT admission_id, icd_code, severity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY admission_id ORDER BY diagnosis_id) AS rn FROM silver.diagnoses) dx ON dx.admission_id = a.admission_id AND dx.rn = 1',

query: 'SELECT b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk, b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, a.patient_id, a.department, ISNULL(NULLIF(b.charge_type,\'\'),\'Sin clasificar\') AS tipo_cargo, b.payment_status AS estado_pago, CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), b.payment_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_pago_key, b.amount AS monto_facturado, 1 AS conteo_transacciones FROM silver.billing b INNER JOIN silver.admissions a ON a.admission_id = b.admission_id',

admission_date = coalesce(iif(regexMatch(admission_date,'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(admission_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(null())), toDate(admission_date,'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(admission_date,'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(admission_date,'MMMM d, yyyy'), toDate(admission_date,'MM-dd-yy')),

discharge_date = coalesce(iif(regexMatch(discharge_date,'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(discharge_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(null())), toDate(discharge_date,'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(discharge_date,'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(discharge_date,'MMMM d, yyyy'), toDate(discharge_date,'MM-dd-yy')),

payment_date = coalesce(iif(regexMatch(payment_date,'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(payment_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(null())), toDate(payment_date,'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(payment_date,'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(payment_date,'MMMM d, yyyy'), toDate(payment_date,'MM-dd-yy'))) ~> limpiezaFacturacion
date_of_birth = coalesce(toDate(date_of_birth,'MMMM d, yyyy'), toDate(date_of_birth,'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(date_of_birth,'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(date_of_birth,'yyyy-MM-dd')),
